checks: Registration creates an unverified development identity
Anonymous and unverified customers cannot trade
Verified login passes the paused-MFA status service
Concurrent simulated purchase provisions exactly one $25K account
Protected accounts cannot bypass the shared two-factor gate
Account creation delivers one activation message to the local test mailbox
Trading requires activation and concurrent activations emit one confirmation
Concurrent order retries execute once and ignore client-supplied financial fields
Reusing an idempotency key for a different order is rejected
SL/TP can be edited and removed through the same authenticated account API
Another customer cannot read or close the account
Firestore rules reject client balance tampering
Partial and final closes update the shared authoritative snapshot
Closed target passes phase one and atomically creates phase two
Failed challenge liquidates, disables trading, and preserves records
A rejected close persists its automatic stop fill and replays without executing twice
limitations: Lifecycle messages are delivered to the isolated local mailbox; external SMTP delivery is not tested.
Real provider OAuth, commercial data and iOS visual acceptance are separate checks.
